# Auth threshold exposes show/set and preserves connect-only behavior when no
# daemon is running.
spacewave auth threshold --help
stdout "show or set the multi-sig auth threshold"
stdout "set the multi-sig auth threshold"

! spacewave auth threshold --state-path $WORK/state
stderr "no daemon listening"

! spacewave auth threshold set --state-path $WORK/state 2
stderr "no daemon listening"
